UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

_CORONA_HALO_R

Corona recipe — all sprite-space fractions of the half-edge. Light, not geometry: stroked lines and wedges read as drawn rays no matter how soft their gradient, so the corona is now layered luminance only — a wide atmospheric halo, a hot photosphere knot, irregular flare knots at the limb, and prominence filaments built as CHAINS of shrinking soft blobs along a curved magnetic-loop path (each link a radial gradient — nothing with a hard edge survives to crayon).

_CORONA_HALO_SHADE

Halo/photosphere shade factors — low values keep the body's own tint saturated; shading far toward white washed coronas into gray fog.

_CORONA_FRINGE_R

Chromatic limb wash — refracted blue light spread through a broad, shallow gradient (no distinct ring — a thin annulus renders as a rainbow eye at small sprite sizes).

_CORONA_WISP_STEPS

Blobs per prominence filament — enough to fuse into one curve.

_CORONA_WISP_BR

Blob radius at the limb root of a filament (fraction of mid).

_CORONA_WISP_TAPER

How much the filament thins toward its tip (0..1).

_CORONA_PLUME_MIN

Activity threshold above which a star throws eruption plumes — quiet dwarfs (≤1.2) keep only gentle limb prominences.

_CORONA_PLUME_COUNT

Plume count base/variance, reach multiplier vs normal wisps, extra bend (ejecta whips harder), blob size/alpha at the arc root.

_CORONA_CUT_IN

Corona photosphere cutout — inner mask radius (×ball radius) and outer feather edge: inside the sphere is cleared to transparent, and the fade ends just past the limb so a slim chromosphere ring survives.

coronaFor

Generates a seeded star-corona sprite — the "alive" layer that turns a lit disc into a sun: a warm photosphere glow, seeded radial streamers at uneven lengths, and a few flare knots. The sprite rotates slowly in updateFx so the streamers shimmer.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Star def (color = streamer tint, id = seed).
  • @returns A CanvasTexture for the corona sprite map, or undefined.
